description: This source file defines the WebToLeadFormBuilder class, which provides static methods to generate HTML forms for web-to-lead submissions in SuiteCRM. The class includes functions for building form structure, fields, and scripts, handling different input types, and integrating with the SuiteCRM environment.

classes.name: WebToLeadFormBuilder
classes.description: A utility class for dynamically generating HTML web-to-lead forms with various input fields, styles, and scripts tailored for SuiteCRM.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Main method to generate the complete HTML form for web-to-lead submission, incorporating multiple fields, layout, and scripts based on provided parameters.

methods.name: getFormStartHTML
methods.description: Constructs the opening part of the form, including style definitions and initial HTML tags.

methods.name: getFormFooterHTML
methods.description: Constructs the footer part of the form, including submit button and hidden input fields.

methods.name: getFormFinishHTML
methods.description: Appends closing tags and JavaScript for form validation and submission control.

methods.name: getRowStartHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML to start a new row layout.

methods.name: getRowFinishHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML to close a row layout.

methods.name: getColFieldStartHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML to start a column within a row.

methods.name: getColFieldFinishHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML to close a column.

methods.name: getFieldLabelHTML
methods.description: Creates HTML for a label for a form field, including indication if the field is required.

methods.name: getFieldEmptyHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML placeholder for empty or unassigned fields.

methods.name: getFieldEnumHTML
methods.description: Creates HTML for enum-type fields, either select, radio, or multi-select, based on field metadata.

methods.name: getFieldEnumMultiSelectHTML
methods.description: Constructs HTML for a multi-select enum field.

methods.name: getFieldEnumRadioGroupHTML
methods.description: Constructs HTML for enum options displayed as radio buttons.

methods.name: getFieldEnumSelectHTML
methods.description: Constructs HTML for a single select dropdown for enum fields.

methods.name: getFieldBoolHTML
methods.description: Creates HTML for a boolean checkbox input.

methods.name: getFieldDateHTML
methods.description: Creates HTML input for date fields.

methods.name: getFieldCharsHTML
methods.description: Creates HTML input for text or email fields.

methods.name: getFieldTextHTML
methods.description: Creates HTML input for large text areas.

methods.name: getFieldRelateHTML
methods.description: Creates HTML input for relate fields (linked to other entities).

methods.name: getFieldEmailHTML
methods.description: Creates HTML input for email fields, including opt-in checkbox if enabled.

methods.name: getOptInCheckboxHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML for opt-in checkbox based on configuration.

methods.name: getFormTwoColumns
methods.description: Determines the optimal number of columns for multi-column form layout.

methods.name: getBooleanFields
methods.description: Concatenates boolean field identifiers into a string.

methods.name: getArrayOfFieldInfo
methods.description: Gathers metadata about a field for form generation, including label, type, options, and required status.
